critique: The proved contribution is an exact rational-covariance frontier: deterministic polynomial-time numerical edge identification at maximum indegree one and promise universal-real completeness at indegree two on bounded directed components. Its hard-side novelty is specifically the bounded-fan-in replacement of Dörfler et al.'s storage star; general universal-real hardness and fiber bijectivity are inherited, while the K_G results are padding consequences rather than an additional identification frontier. The result supplies no stability analysis for approximate covariances, finite-sample inference, implementation, or substantive MIIVsem demonstration, so the named practical consumer is not supported by delivered evidence. The framing does not claim those omitted inferential results, but the exact-input scope and narrow hard-side delta constrain its significance and projected leading-econometrics-journal score.
